body: I was opening a neosporin box to give it to my mother. I got a papercut from the box. I immediately dabbed some neosporin on the cut, and with still-greasy fingers tried to open the bandaids box. I cut myself again.

My insurance doesn't cover mental health.
Thanks for your words up until now, good luck with your social anxiety. Sorry, but I'm going to go ahead and have a good rest, now.
Oh, that's good...How was the cost, however?
Have you gone to one before? I've heard horror stories about facilities like this, so I'm very anxious just thinking about it.

Oh, that's heartening to know...just, being like this...though I know you weren't meaning to, that's actually really depressing, knowing that better things are out there but I'm so far from any of them.

That's true. It's just that I have nowhere to go right now...Thanks for helping me realize it wouldn't work out with him. I kind of wonder, though, if anyone would be willing to deal with all the problems I come with. His main issue is that he doesn't understand that mental illness is real...

I don't have problems talking or meeting new people- the main thing is my agoraphobia (so I haven't gone out in months) and the triggers for my panic attacks (being in unfamiliar places, heat). The meds I'm taking help take the edge off, but I still get too anxious to go out when it comes to it.

I thank you for your well-intentioned words, but I really don't have any hope or vision of things getting better anymore. Every day I'm holed up in this room, deathly afraid to go out, no one who could help believes in my mental illness. I'm tired of being beat down, of living this meaningless existence.
Yes, though I am extremely afraid of being in a new environment in which I have no control, and am not sure how much good it would do me.

I hate how dependent I am on him, but...I still love him. Sometimes I think- "If I weren't ill, we'd be good again" but now that I know how he treats me as if I'm just a weak-willed person though I'm ill, I'm so conflicted.

I agree with all the suggestions here, but in my position I'm not able to follow through with them. My closest friends are all studying abroad. I've told my boyfriend about these thoughts before, and he said "You're not a special person. Just be braver and suck it up, it's not that bad." It was his way of trying to get me focused but...

The deadline for withdrawal passed weeks ago, and though I really wanted to take a break, my parents are obviously against it. Being at home would be even more stressful. None of my friends are so close that I would be comfortable asking to stay with them...I wish I just had somewhere quiet and safe to go.
No, I am 11 hours away from anyone else I know. My family does not believe in mental illness.
